title: History workspace: stage reference images from a + button, with the active entry as a visible numbered chip

summary: Compact plan attached (plan.md): + button opens MpiMediaPicker in the history PromptBox, active entry renders as a numbered chip, strip order is slot order.

Step 1 landed: MpiPromptBox gains the stageMedia prop, the + card wired to MpiMediaPicker, el.setPinnedMedia() and the pinned chip flag. Both lints clean. Drift found and fixed in the same step - the history-mode CSS hid the media strip outright, so the + button and every chip would have rendered into display:none.

Steps 2 and 3 landed. PromptBox: no persistence/restore for history plus a one-time sweep of an older build's slot, and the pinned chip exempted from every capacity eviction path (and from clearMedia). History block: _setCurrentIdx / _syncEntryChip funnel all ten _currentIdx writes, stageMedia on for image groups, MPI-351's clearMedia retired, the image-group discard AND prepend deleted, imageCount floor dropped. lint + lint:components clean, npm test 918/918, electron-smoke 1 passed. Not yet exercised in a running app - verify mode is user-ux.

Fabio verified the feature in his own app - a masked krea2Edit with a reference image in an image history group, the hole this card exists to close. Step 4 done (types.js: stageMedia, setPinnedMedia, the changed clearMedia contract; docs/workspaces.md: the image-group media contract, the two-drop-zone split, and why video is not it). One regression found in that check and fixed: the strip band is full-width at bottom:100% of a SHELL-level #prompt-box-mount, so it swallowed clicks on the bottom of the history tool rail - pointer-events none on the band, auto on __chip and __add. Needs a re-check in the app.

Two UI follow-ups from Fabio's app check. (1) Chips now start past the tool rail - the strip band is anchored at a SHELL-level #prompt-box-mount, so left:0 is the window edge, not the workspace's. (2) The rail is 72px -> 88px: its section labels were clipping, and the real cause was MpiHistoryTools sizing to the widest ICON rather than the rail, so width:100% labels overflowed centred and lost their first letter to overflow-x:hidden. One shared --history-rail-w in styles/01_base.css binds the block's grid column to the strip's inset. Claim extended to the three new files after checking no live peer held them. Lints clean; needs an eyes-on pass.

reason: Verified live by Fabio in his own app: masked krea2Edit with a staged reference image, plus the three UI fixes. Lints clean, 918/918 tests, boot smoke passed.
